author: reek
body: Cross-probing between schematic and PCB editors. When a user clicks a component in the schematic, the PCB editor highlights and centers on the corresponding footprint, and vice versa. Also supports net highlighting across both views.

author: reek
body: Given a component reference, find its location in the schematic (sheet + x/y) or PCB (x/y/layer). These are stubs that return coordinates -- the real implementation walks the design data.
